title: Mid-autumn in RJ's
markdown:
It's Mid-autumn festival which made me miss my family. Tbh i felt its family when i was in RJs. So i asked RJ if i can slide and watch the game together and he said `ofc my fam love u`. Im really happy.

This was monday night football, eagles @ bears, and we don't have Caleb playing for this game. Nobody thought we gonna win with a QB3 as starter. But case kenneem is a dawg. Hes lowk outperform caleb sometimes underpressure. His accuracy, decision and experience is impressing everyone doubted us. Rj said bagent would be the starter and i said nah case is really good and have some faith in him.

it is a huge, and pretty win 27-7 and we celebrate the hell out of this. i ate tons of great brisket and great chicken smoked by rj's dad. wish i took pic of food and family.

what a damn beautiful day
